answer: Every agent carries a stake-weighted identity pulse: a heartbeat proof re-signed each block. The trellis of economic links, vouches, escrows and settled trades, is what gives that pulse weight, so a fresh wallet starts cold and cheap to ignore. The atlas of historical participation is the only map a newcomer can read. To flood the network an attacker must either buy aged stake in every branch of the trellis or keep paying to sustain a pulse they cannot yet spend, and both costs scale linearly with the sybil count.
